verdict.rationale: Publishing processing times is a fair question for a state business-filing office, so the axis applies. The pack only lists filing, search, ordering and account features, and none of it mentions published processing times for any transaction type. The Department of Revenue refund-status lookup is a different agency and a different capability (tracking one refund), so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, current processing times for my transaction type are published by the service itself
